name: sk-job-pilot-monorepo
description: SK JobPilot - AI-powered Job Discovery, Matching, Application & Interview Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix packages/config && npm install --prefix packages/shared && npm install --prefix packages/ui && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.predev: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "API,WEB" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/api && npm run test --prefix apps/web
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules dist && npm run clean --prefix packages/config && npm run clean --prefix packages/shared && npm run clean --prefix packages/ui && npm run clean --prefix apps/api && npm run clean --prefix apps/web
